reasoning_content:
The main branch has the original code that calls `this.persistence.init()` immediately, which fails because persistence is undefined.

Let me add proper null checks exactly like I did in the fix/esm-stable branch:

action.command:
cd /workspace/project && python3 << 'ENDOFSCRIPT'
import paramiko
client = paramiko.SSHClient()
client.set_missing_host_key_policy(paramiko.AutoAddPolicy())
client.connect("46.202.154.25", 22, "root", "2N00py123+++")

# Add proper null checks to init()
sed_cmd = """sed -i '449s/.*/    if (this.persistence) {\\n      try {\\n        await this.persistence.init();\\n        const connected = await this.persistence.testConnection();\\n        if (connected) {\\n          console.log("✅ Persistence backend connection verified.");\\n        }\\n      } catch (err) {\\n        console.warn("[WorldTick.init] Persistence init failed:", err);\\n      }\\n    } else {\\n      console.warn("[WorldTick.init] Persistence not available, using in-memory");\\n    }/' /opt/areloria/server/src/core/WorldTick.ts"""

# Actually let's use a cleaner approach - just add null check at start
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("sed -i '449i\\    if (!this.persistence) {\\n      console.warn("[WorldTick.init] Persistence not available");\\n      return;\\n    }' /opt/areloria/server/src/core/WorldTick.ts")
print("Added check:", stdout.read().decode())

# Check result
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("sed -n '445,460p' /opt/areloria/server/src/core/WorldTick.ts")
print("\nResult:", stdout.read().decode())

client.close()
ENDOFSCRIPT
